name: O.R. Tambo International Airport

hours.v: aerodrome operator, ATS, fuelling and handling all 24 hours

noise.v: no runway intersection take-offs 2000-0400; no engine run-ups 2000-0400 without the airport manager's prior permission (except emergency) (times as printed in the AIP)
noise.quote: No RWY intersection take-off BTN 2000 to 0400.

notes: 1 Nov 2026: read the SACAA AIP amendment file for FAOR (AD 2 FAOR pages, effective 15 OCT 26, AMDT 4/26) https://caasanwebsitestorage.blob.core.windows.net/aip-ammendments/FA_AD_2_FAOR_EN.pdf . It holds only the amended pages (AD 2-FAOR-2 to -4 and -17 onward): AD 2.3 hours, AD 2.4 fuel, AD 2.20 and AD 2.21. AD 2.12 runway dimensions are not in it, so runway stays missing. AD 2.20 has no slot, PPR or general aviation rule; AD 2.21 limits intersection take-offs and run-ups 2000-0400 (times as printed; whether UTC or local was not checked; not a curfew). The AIP does not show the IATA code. Still not opened: the full Aerodromes AIP https://caasanwebsitestorage.blob.core.windows.net/aeronautical-information-publication/Aerodromes%20%2815_OCT_2026%29.PDF (listed on https://www.caa.co.za/industry-information/aip-amendments/). The ATNS eAIP (cad.atns.co.za) only has editions to 2022 (superseded). ACSA's O.R. Tambo 'about' page gives no runway, hours or customs facts.
